description: This file defines the 'Language' class within the OpenCart system, responsible for managing language text strings, including loading language files, retrieving, setting, and clearing language data, with support for path management and caching.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Class for handling language translation strings including loading language files, retrieving, setting, and managing language data with caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Language object with a language code.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a path to the namespace for loading language files.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a language string by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a language string for a key.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all language strings, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a language file, potentially caching it and prefixing keys.
